title.narrative: Youth Advisory Board – Make it Happen!

description.narrative:
The Youth Action Lab (YAL) has youth leadership at its core. A Youth Advisory Board (YAB) leads participatory grant-making to youthacross Africa and Europe, from start to finish! With the PDF, we aim to: 1) Strengthen the YAB during the start-up phase and experiment on participatory grant-making; 2) Invest in capturing lessons and best practices to share with projects that invest in youth leadership 3) Establish and promote an innovative model for youth as part of governing structures of use for other projects.
Young people are a key rights-holders group for ER4A and part of our long-term vision. In line with the Manifesto, we aim to be an ally to youth and ensure meaningful youth engagement. We see the need and urgency to continue and scale this work. Meaningful youth engagement has shown to increase impact and nurture sustainability of results. We want to experiment and showcase an innovative YAB as key vehicle for investing in this – using co-creation as a core methodology from the start to develop a partnership and funding mechanismswith young people that truly embodies their leadership and meaningful youth engagement. The YAL project has started this year, and the funds will deepen and enhance the impact the YAB can have on the project and set an example for other ONL projects on youth leadership. We see a strong fit in terms of supporting the work of activists and movements, not only will we provide direct support, butwe will also ensure youth themselves have the decision-making power over how and who to support

participating-org.narrative:
Restless Development Tanzania is a leading youth-led development agency that has been working in Tanzania since 1993. Our mission is to champion youth-led change, empowering young people to take on leadership roles and influence decisions that impact their lives.We work with young people on issues like education, livelihoods, sexual and reproductive health, and climate change.
Our Policies We commit to our Code of Conduct – We hold ourselves to high standards of ethical, respectful, and responsible behaviour in everything we do.
We act professionally – We show up on time, stay accountable, and represent Restless Development with integrity and respect.
We don’t tolerate inappropriate behaviour – We speak up, report concerns, and support each other in creating a safe and respectful environment.
We lead with integrity – We are honest, transparent, and consistent in our actions and decisions.
We celebrate diversity – We respect and value different identities, experiences, and voices, making space for everyone to thrive.
We protect confidentiality – We handle information with care and only share what’s necessary, in the right way, at the right time.
We create a safeand healthy workplace – We look after our own well-being and support our colleagues to do the same—physically, emotionally, and mentally.
We grow together – We invest in our own development and help others learn and lead too.
We follow our policies – We know the rules, stay informed, and act in line with our values andprocedures.
We communicate with respect – We listen actively, speak kindly, and ensure our messages are inclusive, clear, and values-driven.
We say no to unlawful and offensive behaviour – We stand against harassment, discrimination, and anything that harms or excludes others.
We live our Action Code – We bring our values to life every day through our words, choices, and actions.
